name: usage-ledger-off-by-default
description: The usage ledger plugin (#723) loads, registers /usage, and reports that it is off by default. No provider is called and nothing is written: the throwaway HOME from the harness holds no plugins.usage_ledger.enabled setting. Recording and rollups are covered by tests/unit/test_usage_ledger.py and tests/unit/plugins/test_usage_ledger_plugin.py.

steps.description: message names the config key to enable it
